name: nested_repl
title: Nested replication inside a concatenation source
description: {2{3{Sign}}, In} nests a replication inside a replication (6 copies of Sign) and appends the 2-bit In payload, wiring an 8-bit Word straight to the output. Word bits 1-2 are In, bits 3-8 are Sign; e.g. In=2,Sign=1 gives 254 and In=3,Sign=1 gives 255.
